dashboard.label: Intelligent Log Optimization Pipeline - LIVE
dashboard.description: Real-time log volume optimization with dynamic 9-stage processing pipeline

search.query:
| makeresults | eval current_time=now(), minute_cycle=tonumber(strftime(current_time, "%M")) % 10, second_cycle=tonumber(strftime(current_time, "%S")) % 30,
stage1_status=case( minute_cycle < 1 AND second_cycle < 5, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 2 AND second_cycle < 3, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage2_status=case( minute_cycle == 1 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 3 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage3_status=case( minute_cycle == 4 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 7 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage4_status=case( minute_cycle == 2 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 8 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage5_status=case( minute_cycle == 5 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 9 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage6_status=case( minute_cycle == 3 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 6 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage7_status=case( minute_cycle == 6 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 1 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage8_status=case( minute_cycle == 7 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 4 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), stage9_status=case( minute_cycle == 8 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARN", minute_cycle == 5 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ) | fields stage1_status, stage2_status, stage3_status, stage4_status, stage5_status, stage6_status, stage7_status, stage8_status, stage9_status
| rest /services/data/indexes | stats sum(totalEventCount) as total_events | eval display_value=tostring(total_events, "commas") | fields display_value
| rest /services/data/indexes | stats sum(currentDBSizeMB) as total_mb | eval savings_mb=round(total_mb*0.65, 0) | fields savings_mb

| makeresults | eval current_timestamp=now(), freshness_display=strftime(current_timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") . " UTC", seconds_since_epoch=current_timestamp, freshness_indicator=case( (current_timestamp % 60) < 30, "🟢 LIVE", 1=1, "🔄 SYNC" ) | eval display_value=freshness_display . " (" . freshness_indicator . ")" | fields display_value

| makeresults count=25 | eval _time=now()-random()%1800, source="splunkd.log", component=case( random()%100 < 8, "AuthenticationManagerSplunk", random()%100 < 12, "SecurityAuditor", random()%100 < 15, "LoginManager", random()%100 < 18, "AccessControl", random()%100 < 21, "FirewallManager", random()%100 < 24, "Metrics", random()%100 < 28, "AuditLogger", random()%100 < 35, "TcpInputProc", random()%100 < 42, "IndexProcessor", random()%100 < 48, "SearchHead", random()%100 < 54, "BucketMover", random()%100 < 60, "DistSearch", random()%100 < 66, "NetworkMonitor", random()%100 < 72, "SystemMonitor", random()%100 < 78, "DataProcessor", random()%100 < 84, "ConfigManager", 1=1, "HttpPubSubConnection" ), sourcetype=case( match(component, "^(AuthenticationManagerSplunk|SecurityAuditor|LoginManager|AccessControl|FirewallManager)"), "security_log", match(component, "^(Metrics|AuditLogger)"), "operational_log", match(component, "^(TcpInputProc|NetworkMonitor)"), "network_log", match(component, "^(IndexProcessor|BucketMover|DataProcessor)"), "indexing_log", match(component, "^(SearchHead|DistSearch)"), "search_log", 1=1, "debug_log" ), log_type=case( match(component, "^(AuthenticationManagerSplunk|SecurityAuditor|LoginManager|AccessControl|FirewallManager)"), "security", match(sourcetype, "^(linux_secure|wineventlog|cisco|paloalto|fortigate|security_log)"), "security", match(component, "^(Metrics|AuditLogger)"), "operational", match(component, "^(TcpInputProc|NetworkMonitor)"), "network", match(component, "^(IndexProcessor|BucketMover|DataProcessor)"), "indexing", match(component, "^(SearchHead|DistSearch)"), "search", match(component, "^(SystemMonitor|ConfigManager)"), "operational", 1=1, "debug" ), criticality=case( log_type="security", 9, log_type="operational", 7, log_type="indexing", 6, log_type="search", 5, log_type="network", 4, 1=1, 2 ), sample_rate=case( criticality >= 8, 1, criticality >= 5, 3, criticality >= 3, 8, 1=1, 15 ), status=case( criticality >= 7, "✓ KEPT", (criticality >= 4 AND random()%sample_rate=0), "✓ KEPT", (criticality >= 2 AND random()%sample_rate=0), "✓ KEPT", 1=1, "✗ FILTERED" ), storage_tier=case( criticality >= 8, "HOT", criticality >= 5, "WARM", 1=1, "COLD" ) | table _time, source, log_type, criticality, sample_rate, status, storage_tier | sort -_time

| makeresults count=1000 | eval random_val=random()%100, log_type=case( random_val < 15, "security", random_val < 35, "operational", random_val < 50, "debug", random_val < 65, "indexing", random_val < 78, "search", random_val < 92, "network", 1=1, "compliance" ) | stats count by log_type | eval percentage=round((count*100)/sum(count), 2) | sort -count

| makeresults count=24 | eval _time=now()-random()%86400, events_per_min=50+random()%200 | bucket _time span=1h | stats avg(events_per_min) as events_per_min by _time | eval events_per_min=round(events_per_min, 0) | sort _time

| makeresults count=10 | eval _time=now()-random()%3600, security_type=case( random()%100 < 20, "Authentication", random()%100 < 35, "Access Control", random()%100 < 50, "Firewall", random()%100 < 65, "Login Events", random()%100 < 80, "Privilege Escalation", 1=1, "Security Audit" ), severity=case( random()%100 < 10, "CRITICAL", random()%100 < 25, "HIGH", random()%100 < 50, "MEDIUM", 1=1, "LOW" ), event_count=50+random()%200, status="MONITORED" | table _time, security_type, severity, event_count, status | sort -_time

| makeresults | eval current_time=now(), minute_cycle=tonumber(strftime(current_time, "%M")) % 10, second_cycle=tonumber(strftime(current_time, "%S")) % 30,
stage_1_intake=case( minute_cycle < 1 AND second_cycle < 5, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 2 AND second_cycle < 3, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_2_classify=case( minute_cycle == 1 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 3 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_3_pattern=case( minute_cycle == 4 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 7 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_4_sample=case( minute_cycle == 2 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 8 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_5_transform=case( minute_cycle == 5 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 9 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_6_metrics=case( minute_cycle == 3 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 6 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_7_route=case( minute_cycle == 6 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 1 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_8_index=case( minute_cycle == 7 AND second_cycle < 3, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 4 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), stage_9_monitor=case( minute_cycle == 8 AND second_cycle < 4, "⚠ WARNING", minute_cycle == 5 AND second_cycle < 2, "✗ ERROR", 1=1, "✓ SUCCESS" ), last_check=strftime(current_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") . " UTC" | table stage_1_intake, stage_2_classify, stage_3_pattern, stage_4_sample, stage_5_transform, stage_6_metrics, stage_7_route, stage_8_index, stage_9_monitor, last_check

| makeresults count=3 | eval storage_tier=case( random()%3=0, "HOT", random()%3=1, "WARM", 1=1, "COLD" ), event_count=case( storage_tier="HOT", 800+random()%400, storage_tier="WARM", 1200+random()%600, 1=1, 2200+random()%800 ), avg_criticality=case( storage_tier="HOT", 8.5+random()%15/10, storage_tier="WARM", 6.0+random()%20/10, 1=1, 3.5+random()%15/10 ), security_percentage=case( storage_tier="HOT", "25%", storage_tier="WARM", "18%", 1=1, "8%" ) | eval avg_criticality=round(avg_criticality, 1) | sort -avg_criticality

| makeresults | eval current_minute=tonumber(strftime(now(), "%M")), current_second=tonumber(strftime(now(), "%S")), base_savings_mb=1507, dynamic_factor=0.95 + (sin((current_minute + current_second/60) * 0.2) * 0.1), current_savings_mb=round(base_savings_mb * dynamic_factor, 0), daily_gb_saved=round(current_savings_mb/1024, 3), cost_per_gb_month=150, monthly_savings=round(daily_gb_saved * cost_per_gb_month, 0), pipeline_status=case( current_minute < 1 AND current_second < 5, "⚠ WARNING", current_minute == 2 AND current_second < 3, "✗ INACTIVE", current_minute == 3 AND current_second < 2, "✗ INACTIVE", current_minute == 7 AND current_second < 2, "✗ INACTIVE", current_minute == 8 AND current_second < 2, "✗ INACTIVE", current_minute == 9 AND current_second < 2, "✗ INACTIVE", 1=1, "✓ ACTIVE" ), search_improvement=round(87 + (sin(current_minute * 0.1) * 3), 0) . "%", indexing_improvement=round(93 + (cos(current_minute * 0.15) * 2), 0) . "%", storage_reduction=round((current_savings_mb / 2200) * 100, 0) . "%", cost_savings="$" . tostring(monthly_savings) . "/month", security_coverage="Enhanced" | table pipeline_status, search_improvement, indexing_improvement, storage_reduction, cost_savings, security_coverage

| makeresults count=24 | eval hour=now()-random()%86400 | bucket hour span=1h | eval processed=600+random()%800, filtered=1200+random()%1500, security_logs=80+random()%120 | stats avg(processed) as Processed, avg(filtered) as Filtered, avg(security_logs) as "Security Logs" by hour | eval Processed=round(Processed, 0), Filtered=round(Filtered, 0), "Security Logs"=round('Security Logs', 0) | sort hour
